_about: Rules for analysis goals (R/goals.R). Agreed vocabulary: docs/contracts/analysis_goals.md; the goal registry lives in Biodes (studyforge inst/registry/analysis_goals.json).
_note_trend_log: a trend factor with scale 'log': the slope is fitted on log_base(value + log_offset), with log_base and log_offset from the spec factor (Biodes 0.6.2). Without log_base: trend_log_base_default. Without log_offset: the smallest positive value when a value is <= 0, else 0. Simitall plants on the same predictor; goal_recovery checks it (predictor_match).
effect_scale_outcome: the model scale of the engine
_note_effect_scale_outcome: goal_effect.scale = 'outcome' is read as the scale the engine estimates on (engines.tsv estimate_scale): outcome units for continuous outcomes, log2 fold change for counts, log odds for binary, M-value for methylation.
within_group_level_match: case-insensitive exact, then a unique partial match
_note_within_group: time_course with goal_effect.time_course.scope = 'within_group', group and group_factor: group becomes the reference level of group_factor and the time main-effect coefficients are tested jointly (time within that group). Without a group:time interaction in the model, or a group Bioana cannot find, time is tested over all groups and the report says so.
_note_hidden_factors: Simitall hidden factors (sim_truth.json counts.hidden_factors: scores per unit, loadings per gene). Bioana fits its design model to each gene's hidden part (loadings %*% scores) and takes the goal's coefficient(s): the hidden-factor effect on what the goal tests (log2). An unplanted call is attributed to hidden factors when, for a one-coefficient goal, that effect has the estimate's sign and at least hidden_factor_share of its size; for joint tests, when its largest coefficient is at least hidden_factor_effect_large.
_note_hidden_factor_share: 0.25: called genes carry noise on top of the hidden effect (selected for size), so the hidden share of an estimate is below 1 even when hidden factors caused the call. Checked on Simitall 399c1ff dose design: 123/132 unplanted calls had share >= 0.3, 4 had < 0.1.
